planPrices.title: Pricing
planPrices.description: Monthly and yearly prices for this plan. Multiple historical prices are kept; only one can be active per billing cycle and currency at a time.

actions.activateDescription: Activate this price? It will become the effective price for its billing cycle and currency.
actions.deactivateDescription: Deactivate this price? It will no longer be charged to new subscriptions.

form.createDescription: Add a new price for this plan.
form.editDescription: Billing cycle and currency cannot be changed after creation.
form.currencyCodeDescription: 3-letter uppercase currency code. Leave blank to default to BDT.
form.currencyCodePattern: Currency code must be exactly 3 uppercase letters.
form.amountDescription: Up to 4 decimal places, cannot be negative.
form.amountInvalid: Amount must be a non-negative number with up to 4 decimal places.
form.effectiveFromDescription: Defaults to today if left blank.
form.effectiveToDescription: Leave blank for an open-ended price.
form.effectiveToBeforeFrom: Effective-to date must be later than effective-from date.
form.isActiveDescription: Only one active price is allowed per billing cycle and currency for overlapping periods.
